decision_conditions: The proposed quantum of residential development, comprising six dwellings, is not considered appropriate to the size, character and context of the site. Having regard to the uniform, low-rise character of the surrounding area, the amount of development proposed would represent an over-intensive form of development that would be out of keeping with the prevailing pattern of development and would be unlikely to be capable of being accommodated on the site in a manner that would secure an acceptable standard of residential amenity and protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy CP2 of the Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD6, DMD7 and DMD38 of the Development Management Document (2014), Policies H1 and H2 of the London Plan (2021), and emerging Policies DE1 and H4 of the Draft New Enfield Local Plan.
